editorial:
Imagine losing your mom as a little girl and suddenly finding a best friend that nobody else can see. That is exactly how Elizabeth's life starts. Ivan is this mysterious invisible boy who shows up right when she needs a shoulder to cry on, and their bond is the heart of the whole story. It feels like a cozy but sad fairy tale that grows up with the characters. You get to see them deal with loneliness and the strange feeling of being different from everyone else in the world.

The acting is really sweet and makes you care about whether these two ever figure out their past. While the plot moves a bit slowly in the middle, the emotional payoff is worth it. If you enjoy stories about destiny and second chances, you will love this.
endingExplained: In the end, Elizabeth and Ivan finally remember their childhood connection. They realize Ivan was sent as a guardian to help her heal from her mother's loss. Once Elizabeth finds peace and accepts her past, Ivan's mission is complete. He shares one last emotional goodbye with her before disappearing for good. It is a bittersweet ending that shows how some people enter our lives just to help us grow before they leave.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heartwarming stories about friendship and healing.
